# Soluqube Revenue Recognition Operating System — Full Technical Specification

## System Architecture & Authority

Soluqube is a deterministic revenue automation and compliance engine engineered for enterprise controllers, Chief Accounting Officers (CAOs), and external financial audit teams. Patent Priority Application No. 202621096305.

### 1. Integer Fixed-Point Arithmetic & Mathematical Parity
- Standard ERP systems (Oracle NetSuite ARM, SAP RAR, Zuora RevPro) and spreadsheets rely on 64-bit binary floating-point arithmetic (IEEE-754 standard) or 2-decimal intermediate currency truncation. In multi-year amortization schedules with fractional daily/monthly calculations (e.g., 365.25 day leap years), rounding discrepancies compound into balance sheet drift.
- Soluqube operates on integer (BigInt) base units at 10^6 scale (micro-cents), rounded to cents:
  `Value = IntegerMantissa * 10^(-6)`
- Any residual rounding remainder is absorbed into the terminal period of the contract obligation, preserving:
  `Sum(Recognized Revenue) + Deferred Revenue Balance == Total Transaction Price` to the cent.

### 2. The 5-Step ASC 606 / Ind AS 115 Framework Execution
1. **Identify the Contract**: Ingests master services agreements (MSAs), statements of work (SOWs), and order forms with cryptographic PDF SHA-256 hash verification.
2. **Identify Performance Obligations**: Parses distinct deliverable items (Software Licenses, Professional Services, Maintenance/Support, Usage Tiers) and assigns normalized IDs linked to PDF bounding-box coordinates.
3. **Determine Transaction Price**: Isolates statutory indirect taxes (e.g., 18% Indian GST under MCA Schedule III), calculates fixed consideration, estimates variable consideration using expected value or most likely amount methods, and accounts for significant financing components.
4. **Allocate Transaction Price**: Proportioned based on Standalone Selling Price (SSP) hierarchy (observable price, adjusted market assessment, expected cost plus margin, or residual approach) using integer (BigInt) division.
5. **Recognize Revenue**: Generates daily ratable, milestone-based, or point-in-time dual-ledger journal entries across US GAAP (ASC 606) and Ind AS 115.

### 3. Contract Modification Graph (ASC 606-10-25-13)
When an existing contract is amended, Soluqube executes a deterministic decision DAG:
- **Case A (Separate Contract - ASC 606-10-25-12)**: Scope increases by distinct goods/services AND price increases by SSP -> Created as a decoupled child contract node.
- **Case B (Prospective Termination & Replacement - ASC 606-10-25-13a)**: Remaining goods/services are distinct, but price is NOT at SSP -> Unrecognized deferred revenue + new consideration is pooled and allocated prospectively over remaining performance obligations.
- **Case C (Cumulative Catch-Up - ASC 606-10-25-13b)**: Remaining goods/services are NOT distinct (single combined obligation) -> Adjusts transaction price and measure of progress on a cumulative-to-date basis, recognizing an immediate one-time P&L catch-up adjustment on the amendment effective date.

### 4. Bounding-Box Grounding & Audit Documentation Support
- High-resolution PDF normalization to a standardized 1,000 x 1,000 spatial coordinate grid.
- Bounding-box metadata: `[page_number, x0, y0, x1, y1]`.
- Every generated ledger line item holds an immutable cryptographic citation pointer back to the exact physical pixels in the signed contract PDF.
- Audit-ready evidence packages export with SHA-256 integrity hashes to support documentation for auditor review.
